Annual inspections are conducted separately from semiannual checks.
Semiannual checks are not explicitly mandated in the provided reference material.
A soft brush or compressed air must be used to remove debris from the air-intake CDR valve.
Solvents or abrasive materials must not be used to clean the air-intake CDR valve.

The annual-inspection and air-intake CDR valve information is based on standard maintenance practices for HMMWV (M998-series) as outlined in TM 9-2320-280-20-1, Volume 1 (1996, including Change 2 dated 2004).
